view: Frontal chest radiograph, probably AP (scapulae project over the lateral lung fields), L marker at image upper right consistent with conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate penetration (thoracic spine visible through the heart), slightly low contrast; inspiration fair (about 8-9 posterior ribs); minimal rotation; lung apices and costophrenic angles included; external necklace projects over the lower face/upper neck but does not obscure the lungs

devices.type: Implanted venous access port (triangular PowerPort-type reservoir) with attached catheter looping cephalad over the left upper zone; catheter tip not confidently traced into the SVC
devices.location: Patient's left infraclavicular / anterior upper chest
Projected over the lower face, mandible and upper neck
Mandible / dentition, superior edge of film

abnormalities.finding: Heterogeneous airspace/patchy opacity in the right lower zone with loss of the right hemidiaphragm outline and blunting of the right costophrenic angle - consolidation with probable small pleural effusion or basal atelectasis
Coarse, increased bronchovascular/interstitial markings in the right middle zone with partial silhouetting of the right heart border
Mild retrocardiac and left basal haziness; left costophrenic angle slightly indistinct - possible small left effusion or basal atelectasis
Borderline to mildly enlarged cardiac silhouette (CTR approximately 0.5-0.55) with prominent bilateral perihilar vascular markings

Implanted port catheter loops cephalad over the left upper chest and its distal course/tip cannot be confidently followed into the SVC - possible catheter kink or malposition, correlate with prior films

description_zh: 正面(疑似AP)胸部X光，穿透度尚可、吸氣稍淺，左側前上胸壁可見植入式人工血管(Port-A)裝置，導管向上繞行於左上肺野，遠端走向及尖端無法確認；頸部及下顏面有金屬項鍊與牙科填補物等體外/牙科偽影。右下肺野可見不均勻之肺實質浸潤，右側橫膈輪廓消失、右肋膈角鈍化，考慮右下葉肺炎/實變合併少量肋膜積液或肺底塌陷；右中肺野支氣管血管紋理粗糙增加並部分遮蔽右心緣。左下肺野心後區及左肺底輕度模糊，左肋膈角略不清，不排除少量積液或肺底塌陷。心影邊緣性偏大，兩側肺門血管紋理增加；骨骼及軟組織無明顯異常，未見胸管或引流管。
